## Orientation

Work in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/watch-dashboard. The untracked ~/se-workflow/.artifacts/ is a live store's contract copy: do not edit or commit it. Branch feat/verification-gates exists; do not touch it. The runtime is ~/adaptive-artifacts on branch feat/watch-dashboard, which now has label_fields (view parameter) and the selection clause {"field":"recorded_at","within":"24h"}. The se-workflow tests drive that CLI through tests/conftest.py. A view that uses label_fields must list it in its own parameters array. derived.ready is a JSON boolean. Commit one Conventional Commit.
